title: 第7章 血气丹第8章 灵药种植
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
不能问极阴的情况，但小楼周边的一些环境状况还是可以问的。
“二师兄，小楼外的田地中种植的是？”
“那是师傅种植的灵药，据说合理利用，可以提高我等修士的修为。”
“刚刚来的时候，我看到山脚处有一个山洞，山洞前还设置了石门，”
“那山洞可不是一般的山洞，是师尊炼丹的洞府。”
张成向宋文一一解释，并且他还不忘叮嘱道。
“外面的药田和洞府、包括二楼，这些地方都是禁止我等进入，若没有师尊的准许，你切莫擅闯。”
“多谢师兄指教。”
为了给师兄以及在楼上可能正在探听楼下发生的一切的极阴留下一个好印象，给自己订立一个老实的人设，宋文并没有多问。
在友好送走张成之后，宋文就开始抓紧时间修炼起来。
小楼中得生活像是与世隔绝，极阴也不需要宋文等三人去做任何事情，时间过得很快，转眼三日过去，一月之期已过。
这日清晨，宋文起床，正准备往厢房区域而去，开启每日的早课。
然而，大师兄二牛却告知他。
“三师弟，师尊让我转告你和二师弟，从今日开始，不用再去厢房那边上早课了。”
宋文闻言，顿时双目微眯，远远眺望着厢房区域。
往日人头攒动的厢房区，今日却是空无一人。
二牛注意到宋文的举动，他主动解释道。
“师尊已将他们遣散了，他们没有仙缘，无法完成引气入体，待着此地已经失去了意义了。”
宋文心中生出一股恶寒，一股冰冷凉意直冲天灵盖，忍不住打了一股寒颤。
这群年轻人恐怕不是被遣散，而是被毁尸灭迹，永远消失在这个世界上了。

宋文脸上挤出一抹笑意。
“多谢大师兄告知，要不然我恐怕就白跑一趟。”
虽说宋文掩饰得很好，但一想到百余名十几岁少年就这样死去，他总感觉恶心反胃和惊惧。
他现在一刻都不会在小楼中待，他想此刻想尽可能远离极阴，追求内心片刻安宁。
“早上的空气不错，我去院落之中走走。”
“我和你一道，这几日一直都在修炼，我也觉得有些枯燥。”
二牛说道，这些天他大多的时间都在二楼，也不知他和极阴在做什么。
宋文点了点头，两人一道往院落中间走去。
一边走，宋文一边打听着二牛的家庭情况。
二牛也不疑有他，没几句话就将自己的家底交代了个干净。
二牛出生在一个偏僻的乡村，家中兄弟姐妹五人，加上父母一家七口，依靠两亩薄田和打猎为生，日子过得极为清贫。
作为家中老大，他从八岁开始，便跟随父亲上山打猎和下地干活了。
家庭贫困，他本来是没有机会识字的，不过村中私塾先生见其家庭困难，心生怜悯，允许二牛免费旁听，这才让二牛有机会识字。
content_en:
You can't ask about extremely cloudy conditions, but you can still ask about some environmental conditions around the small building.
"Second Senior Brother, what are you growing in the fields outside the small building?"
"That is the elixir planted by the master. It is said that if used properly, it can improve the cultivation of monks like us."
"When I first came here, I saw a cave at the foot of the mountain, and there was a stone gate in front of the cave,"
"That cave is not an ordinary cave, it is the cave where Master makes alchemy."
Zhang Cheng explained everything to Song Wen, and he did not forget to give his instructions.
"We are prohibited from entering the medicine fields and caves outside, including the second floor. Without Master's permission, you must not trespass."
"Thank you, senior brother, for your advice."
In order to leave a good impression on his senior brother and Ji Yin who might be snooping about what happened downstairs, and to establish an honest persona for himself, Song Wen didn't ask any more questions.
After sending Zhang Cheng off amicably, Song Wen began to seize the time to practice.
Life in the small building seemed to be isolated from the world, and there was no need for Song Wen and the other three to do anything. Time passed quickly. Three days passed in the blink of an eye, and one month had passed.
Early that morning, Song Wen got up and was about to go to the wing area to start his daily morning class.
However, his senior brother Erniu told him.
"Third Junior Brother, Master asked me to tell you and Second Junior Brother that from today on, you no longer need to go to the wing for morning classes."
When Song Wen heard this, he immediately narrowed his eyes and looked at the wing area from a distance.
The wing area, which used to be crowded with people, was deserted today.
Erniu noticed Song Wen's behavior and took the initiative to explain.
"Master has dismissed them. They have no immortal destiny and cannot complete the process of introducing Qi into their bodies. There is no point in staying here."
A chill arose in Song Wen's heart, and a coldness rushed straight to the sky. He couldn't help but shudder.
I am afraid that these young people were not sent away, but their bodies were destroyed and their traces were destroyed, disappearing from this world forever.
A smile appeared on Song Wen's face.
"Thank you, Senior Brother, for informing me, otherwise I might have made my trip in vain."
Although Song Wen hid it well, he always felt sick and frightened when he thought about hundreds of teenage boys dying like this.
He will not stay in the small building for a moment now. He wants to stay away from Jiyin as much as possible at this moment and pursue a moment of inner peace.
"The air is good in the morning. I'll go for a walk in the courtyard."
"I've been practicing with you for the past few days, and I also feel a little bored."
Erniu said that he spent most of his time on the second floor these days, and he didn't know what he and Jiyin were doing.
Song Wen nodded, and the two of them walked to the middle of the courtyard together.
While walking, Song Wen inquired about Er Niu's family situation.
Erniu didn't doubt his presence, and in a few words he fully explained his family background.
Erniu was born in a remote village. There are five brothers and sisters in his family, plus his parents and a family of seven. They live in extreme poverty on two acres of thin farmland and hunting.
As the eldest son in the family, he followed his father to hunt in the mountains and work in the fields since he was eight years old.
His family was poor and he had no chance to learn how to read. However, seeing his family's difficulties, the teacher at the private school in the village took pity on him and allowed Er Niu to attend for free. This gave Er Niu a chance to learn how to read.
